'''Olga Anatolyevna Dontsova''' (born January 7, 1959) is a Russian biochemist<ref name="a">{{cite web |title=Dontsova Olga Anatolyevna - Intelligent System for Thematic Research of Scientometric Data |url=http://istina.msu.ru/profile/Olkins/ |website=istina.msu.ru |publisher=Research Institute of Mechanics, Moscow State University |accessdate=25 July 2020}}</ref><ref name="b">{{cite web |title=Olga A. Dontsova |url=http://www.chem.msu.su/eng/people/dontsov.html |website=www.chem.msu.su |publisher=ChemNet |accessdate=25 July 2020}}</ref> and an academician at the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |title=РАН получила свежую кровь по итогам выборов новых членов - Новости Mail.Ru |url=https://news.mail.ru/society/27606668/?frommail=1 |date=9 December 2017|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20171209044010/https://news.mail.ru/society/27606668/?frommail=1|archive-date = 9 December 2017}}</ref> Her research interests include: structure and functions of [[RNA]]-containing cellular machines, functional properties and mechanisms of regulation of [[Telomerase]] [[Ribonucleoprotein particle]] (RNP) complexes and non-coding [[RNA]]s.<ref name="a"/>

==Education and work==
In 1991 she defended her Ph.D. from the Chemistry Department of [[Moscow State University]] and in 1997 her doctoral dissertation ''development of chemical methods for studying the structure and function of complex ribonucleoprotein systems'' was published.<ref>{{cite web |title=Развитие химических методов изучения структуры и функции сложных рибонуклеопротеидных систем - диссертация {{!}} ИСТИНА – Интеллектуальная Система Тематического Исследования НАукометрических данных |url=https://istina.msu.ru/dissertations/44664297/ |website=istina.msu.ru}}</ref> Since 1999 she is the professor of Bio-organic chemistry, Department of Chemistry of Natural Compounds at [[MSU Faculty of Chemistry|Faculty of Chemistry]], [[Moscow State University]].<ref name="b"/>

She is the member of the [[Russian Foundation for Basic Research|Russian Foundation for Basic Research Board]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Khlunov Alexander - Portal RFBR |url=https://www.rfbr.ru/rffi/eng/council/o_27379 |website=www.rfbr.ru |publisher=Russian Foundation for Basic Research Board |access-date=25 July 2020 |archive-date=25 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200725165310/https://www.rfbr.ru/rffi/eng/council/o_27379 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
